tweets.author: @svpino
tweets.text:
Summary of how your agents can pay for themselves using the x402 protocol:

1. You give your agent a task
2. The agent finds the tools it wants to use
3. It sends a signed HTTP request
4. The tool sends back an HTTP 402 "Payment Required" response
5. The agent authorizes payment
